long_description:
Grab your furry friend and stretch out together in this fun, chill yoga session for pups and their humans! Great for all skill levels!

About this Event

Bring Your Pup To YogaReady for a fun twist on your usual yoga class? Bring Your Pup To Yoga is the perfect way to stretch, breathe, and bond with your furry best friend. This in-person event lets you and your pup flow through poses together, enjoy some relaxing vibes, and make new friends—both human and doggo! Whether your pup is a seasoned yogi or a curious newbie, it’s all about having a good time. Don’t miss out on this paws-itively awesome experience!
You Must RSVPDogs must meet requirements & have updated profiles at The Wag.Non-Members will be charged a daily rate in addition to the entry fee
